title: Design: a Part Sale price details panel for a % Off rule
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 15.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tiers were set, with a part in category A, cost $189.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Point at the part's Priced By value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The part reads $216.88: $189.00 × 1.35 = $255.15, less 15% = $216.8775, rounded to $216.88.

Step 2:

  • The "Why this price" panel opens under the value with Priced by, Matrix, Cost Range, Rule, Cost, Sell price, Priced on and From, as in picture 13.4.
  • Rule reads "15% off Default ($255.15)".
  • The last line reads customer A's name, "'s Part Sales tier (" tier A's name ") prices its parts."
